description: `--passWithNoTests` with no test file to run, under Jest 30.5.2 (B23b review): Jest still runs its CoverageReporter on an empty map, so the reports are written (an empty `text-summary` and `coverage-summary.json`) and every group that names a path or a glob reports `Jest: Coverage data for <group> was not found.` (`global` adds nothing: an empty summary reads `Unknown`), which makes the run exit 1 despite the flag. Read by `provino`'s `jest-coverage-thresholds.test.ts`.
